title: US Post Offices
hook: The data this week comes from Cameron Blevins and Richard W. Helbock. Their website has more details: Please Cite them when using this data: "Blevins, Cameron; Helbock, Richard W., 2021, "US Post Offices", Harvard Dataverse, V1, UNF:6:8ROmiI5/4qA8jHrt62PpyA== [fileUNF]" US Post Offices is a spatial-historical dataset containing records for 166,140 post offices that operated in the United States between 1639 and 2000. The dataset provides a year-by-year snapshot of the national postal system over multiple centuries, making it one of the most fine-grained and expansive datasets currently available for studying the historical geography of the United States No cleaning this week, although check out the original authors data cleaning/prep steps on their GitHub.
